description: Moves the toolhead in a straight line; Klipper treats it exactly like G1.

parameters.name: E
parameters.description: Filament to extrude over the move.

parameters.name: F
parameters.description: Feed rate in millimetres per minute.

description: Draws a clockwise arc; only available when the printer config enables the arcs section.

parameters.name: I
parameters.description: Centre offset on X from the start point.

parameters.name: J
parameters.description: Centre offset on Y from the start point.

parameters.name: R
parameters.description: Radius, used instead of I and J.

description: Draws a counter-clockwise arc; needs the arcs section in the printer config, like G2.

parameters.name: I
parameters.description: Centre offset on X from the start point.

parameters.name: J
parameters.description: Centre offset on Y from the start point.

parameters.name: R
parameters.description: Radius, used instead of I and J.

description: Pauses the printer for a number of milliseconds.
Retracts the filament using the retraction settings from the printer config; needs the firmware retraction section.
Pushes the filament back after a G10, using the configured settings.
Homes the named axes, or all axes when none are named.
Switches positions to absolute coordinates.
Switches positions to relative coordinates.
Redefines the current position without moving, e.g. G92 E0 to zero the extruder.
Turns the stepper motors off; same as M84. Klipper forgets the homed state afterwards.
Turns the stepper motors off; same as M18.
Lifts the forced relative-extrusion mode set by M83; it does not itself force absolute extruder moves.
Forces extruder moves to be relative even while G90 absolute mode is active.
Sets the hotend target temperature without waiting.
Reports the extruder and bed temperatures.
Sets the part-cooling fan speed.
Turns the part-cooling fan off.
Sets the hotend target and always waits until the temperature has settled there.
Emergency stop: shuts the printer down until it is restarted.
Reports the current toolhead position.
Reports the firmware version.
Shows a message on the printer display (needs a display configured).
Sends a message back to the host console (needs the respond section in the printer config).
Sets the bed target temperature without waiting.
Sets the bed target and always waits until it has settled.

Sets acceleration. S sets one value for everything. Without S, P and T together set it to the lower of the two; with only one of P or T the command does nothing, unlike Marlin where they set print and travel limits separately.

parameters.name: S
parameters.description: Acceleration for all moves, in mm/s^2.

parameters.name: P
parameters.description: With T and no S: one of the two values, the lower wins.

parameters.name: T
parameters.description: With P and no S: one of the two values, the lower wins.

description: Scales the print speed by a percentage.
Scales extrusion by a percentage.
Waits until all queued moves have finished.
Changes the velocity limits set in the printer config for the rest of the session.

parameters.name: MINIMUM_CRUISE_RATIO
parameters.description: Share of a move that must stay at cruise speed.

parameters.name: SQUARE_CORNER_VELOCITY
parameters.description: Speed allowed through a sharp corner, in mm/s.

description: Sets pressure advance for an extruder; slicers emit it per filament.

parameters.name: EXTRUDER
parameters.description: Extruder config name; defaults to the active hotend.

description: Excludes a printed object from the rest of the print; with no parameters it lists the excluded objects.

parameters.name: CURRENT
parameters.description: Set to 1 to exclude the object being printed now.

parameters.name: RESET
parameters.description: Set to 1 to clear the excluded list, or only NAME if given.

description: Declares an object (slicers emit these at the top of the file) so it can be excluded later; with no parameters it lists known objects.

parameters.name: NAME
parameters.description: Identifier used by the other exclude commands.

parameters.name: POLYGON
parameters.description: Outline as a list of X,Y points.

parameters.name: RESET
parameters.description: Set to 1 to forget all defined objects.

parameters.name: JSON
parameters.description: Set to 1 to list objects as JSON.

description: Marks where one object's G-code begins on the current layer.
Marks where the object's G-code ends for the layer; pairs with EXCLUDE_OBJECT_START.

parameters.name: NAME
parameters.description: Optional; only used to warn on a mismatch.

description: Adjusts firmware retraction settings, often set from slicer filament start G-code.

parameters.name: UNRETRACT_EXTRA_LENGTH
parameters.description: Extra filament pushed on unretract, in mm.

description: Sets the speed of a named generic fan, or attaches a display template to drive it.

parameters.name: TEMPLATE
parameters.description: Display template name to drive the fan instead of SPEED.

description: Sets a named heater's target temperature; without TARGET the target becomes 0.
Waits until a temperature sensor is at or above MINIMUM and/or at or below MAXIMUM.
Probes the bed at the configured points and builds a height mesh that is active straight away.

parameters.name: PROFILE
parameters.description: Name to save the mesh under.

parameters.name: METHOD
parameters.description: Set to manual to probe by hand.

parameters.name: HORIZONTAL_MOVE_Z
parameters.description: Z height used for travel between points.

parameters.name: ADAPTIVE
parameters.description: Set to 1 to probe only the area the print uses.

parameters.name: ADAPTIVE_MARGIN
parameters.description: Extra margin around the adaptive area.

description: Loads, saves or removes a stored bed mesh profile.

parameters.name: SAVE
parameters.description: Name to save the current mesh as.

description: Lowers the nozzle until the probe triggers and reports the Z; the parameters override the probe config for this run.

parameters.name: SAMPLES_TOLERANCE
parameters.description: Allowed spread between samples, in mm.

parameters.name: SAMPLES_TOLERANCE_RETRIES
parameters.description: Retries when the spread is too large.

description: Probes the configured points and adjusts each Z stepper independently to level the gantry.
Probes the configured points and adjusts the Z steppers to remove bed tilt.
Adds a positional offset to later moves, such as a live Z offset or a tool XY offset.

parameters.name: MOVE
parameters.description: Set to 1 to move now so the offset applies at once.

parameters.name: MOVE_SPEED
parameters.description: Speed of that move, in mm/s.

description: Saves the G-code parser state (positioning mode, origin, offsets, overrides, speed, position) for macros to restore.
Restores a state saved by SAVE_GCODE_STATE.

parameters.name: MOVE
parameters.description: Set to 1 to move back to the saved position.

parameters.name: MOVE_SPEED
parameters.description: Speed of that move, in mm/s.

description: Pauses the print and remembers the position for RESUME.
Resumes a paused print after moving back to the saved position.
Clears the paused state without resuming, e.g. before cancelling.
Cancels the current print.
Diagnostic: forces the kinematics to believe the toolhead is at a position and sets or clears homed flags.

parameters.name: CLEAR_HOMED
parameters.description: Axes to mark as not homed.

description: Reloads the config and resets the host software; does not clear microcontroller errors.
Like RESTART but also restarts the microcontroller and clears its error state.
